name: selat
description: Discover and call paid AI capabilities via a two-tier loop — vetted multi-step skills first, then free federated x402 / MPP endpoint discovery for possible one-off matches. Current vetted coverage is strongest for B2B enrichment plus financial, social, and web research; on-chain actions are out of scope. interface.shortDescription: Find vetted skills and pay for x402/MPP capabilities from any agent — self-custody.
interface.longDescription: SELAT is a two-tier capability layer for AI agents. It first checks vetted, evaluated multi-step skills (SELAT-AI/selat-skills), then falls back to free federated x402 / MPP endpoint discovery (Circle + MPP + Apify + pay.sh merged) for possible one-off matches. Current vetted coverage is strongest for B2B enrichment plus financial, social, and web research; image/video/audio generation, translation, transcription, messaging, and broad real-world data require a strong discovery match. On-chain actions are out of scope. Payments settle per use from your own Circle Agent Wallet (MPC self-custody): SELAT never sees a private key or holds your funding balance. No per-service signup.
